The '''W-34t turbolaser''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] weapon made by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]]. It cost 9,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and was illegal for civilian use.<ref name="GG6-2" /> The modified [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Storm Killer]]'' mounted a W-34t turbolaser in the dorsal gun turret position.<ref name="Fizzi">{{JournalCite|9|Fizzi's Slightly Used Starships (article)}}</ref>
